title.en: A resume with a stale seq is answered with 412 Precondition Failed

goal.en: Changes to an execution carry If-Match with the seq the caller last saw. If the run moved on, the hub refuses with a Problem and tells the caller the current seq, and nothing changes.

note.en: Start a shakshuka run with a person present.
The arm cuts; the run waits for a person at seq 6.
Resume with seq 1, a value from long ago. The answer is a Problem: title precondition-failed, and the detail names the current seq.
The run did not change: still waiting at seq 6.
Resume again with the seq just read; this time the hub accepts.

cli: jq '. + {"x-hub-human-present": true}' examples/core/execute-request.json | curl -s -X POST http://localhost:7878/v1/executions -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -H 'Idempotency-Key: ex-2026-10-04-001-a' -d @-

outcome.en: You have seen the 412 Problem and that a stale write is harmless. Next: scenario 044 covers idempotent retries of the start itself.
